up: List all distinct compounds that are associated with the document whose ChEMBL ID is CHEMBL3639027. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary) and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Use compound_records to link the document (from docs) to compounds (via molregno). Ensure the list contains unique compounds.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639027';
